label: Velocity
description: The rate of change of position with respect to time, including both speed and direction.

label: Acceleration
description: The rate of change of velocity over time, often caused by forces acting on an object.

label: Force
description: An interaction that changes the motion of an object, described by Newton's laws.

label: Momentum
description: The product of an object's mass and velocity, conserved in isolated systems.

label: Energy
description: The capacity to do work, existing in forms such as kinetic, potential, and thermal.

label: Work
description: The transfer of energy through force applied over a distance.

label: Power
description: The rate at which work is done or energy is transferred.

label: Entropy
description: A measure of disorder or randomness in a system, central to thermodynamics.

label: Temperature
description: A measure of the average kinetic energy of particles in a substance.

label: Pressure
description: Force exerted per unit area, often in fluids and gases.

label: Wave
description: A disturbance that transfers energy through space and matter, such as sound or light.

label: Frequency
description: The number of wave cycles passing a point per unit time.

label: Amplitude
description: The maximum displacement of a wave from its equilibrium position.

label: Photon
description: A quantum of electromagnetic radiation, carrying energy proportional to its frequency.

label: Quantum Superposition
description: The principle that a quantum system can exist in multiple states simultaneously.

label: Uncertainty Principle
description: A quantum rule stating that certain pairs of properties, like position and momentum, cannot be precisely known together.

label: Relativity
description: Einstein's theory describing how space and time are linked and affected by motion and gravity.

label: Black Hole
description: A region of spacetime with gravity so strong that nothing, not even light, can escape.

label: Magnetic Field
description: A field produced by moving charges or magnetic materials, influencing other charges and currents.

label: Electric Field
description: A region around a charged particle where other charges experience a force.
